children: Matinas BioPharma approved and will implement a one-for-fifteen reverse stock split of its common stock effective Sept. 28, 2026.
Board approved a 1:15 reverse stock split to become effective at 12:01 a.m. ET on Sept. 28, 2026.
Shares will trade on a split-adjusted basis under existing symbol MTNB when markets open Sept. 28, 2026.
Fractional shares will not be issued; holders entitled to fractions will receive proportional cash payments.
Reverse split does not change par value, authorized share counts, or materially alter holders’ ownership percentages.
